versions.changelog: No changes detected in this version.

- Renamed skill to "free-models" and added aliases for broader discoverability.
- Updated description to clarify support for both OpenClaw and other AI agents.
- No functional or API changes—documentation improvements only.

- Added advanced model discovery and filtering features, enabling selection by context size, price, provider, and task suitability.
- Introduced getBestFreeModel utility for quick selection of ideal free/cheap models for common agent tasks (reasoning, tool calling, vision).
- Documented example usages and API reference for all model selection functions.
- Provided CLI instructions and environment variable setup for seamless integration.
- Added a quick reference table for top free and budget models on OpenRouter.
